view.scene_description: The image shows an aisle in a brightly lit supermarket with tall shelves stocked with packaged snacks and frozen goods. Decorative hot air balloon and red lantern ornaments hang from the ceiling. A refrigerated display case is visible on the right, near large windows letting in natural light. The floor is tiled, and the ceiling has fluorescent lighting fixtures.

objects.label: shelves
objects.observation: Multi-tiered metal shelving units filled with various snack packages. Located on the left side of the frame, extending into the background. Some items are in wire baskets. Shelves are supported by vertical metal frames and appear to be bolted to the floor. Partially occluded by hanging decorations above.

objects.label: hot air balloon decorations
objects.observation: Yellow and white striped hot air balloon-shaped ornaments suspended from the ceiling. Positioned above the shelves and near the center-right of the frame. They hang freely without visible support wires or brackets. Not touching any surfaces or objects.

objects.label: red lantern decorations
objects.observation: Red paper lanterns hanging from the ceiling on the right side of the frame. They dangle near the windows and above the refrigerated section. No visible attachment points or supports are apparent. They appear to be suspended by thin strings.

objects.label: refrigerated display case
objects.observation: A glass-fronted refrigerated unit on the far right, likely for chilled food items. It sits on the floor against the wall near large windows. Its base is supported by legs or a frame. Partially occluded by other items in the foreground.

objects.label: fluorescent lights
objects.observation: Long rectangular fluorescent light fixtures mounted to the black ceiling. Positioned along the top edge of the frame, illuminating the entire space. They are attached to the ceiling with visible brackets or clips. Emitting bright white light.

objects.label: windows
objects.observation: Large glass windows on the right wall, allowing natural daylight to enter. Located behind the refrigerated case and extending toward the back of the store. Transparent, showing some outdoor scenery. No visible frames or supports beyond the building structure.

prompts.native_chat_prompt_text:
<|im_start|>system
You are a helpful assistant<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>user
<|vision_start|><|image_pad|><|vision_end|>Inspect the photograph. Return ONLY one JSON object, no markdown or text outside JSON. Describe the complete scene and list visible objects with separate local integer IDs, separating instances when possible. For every object describe visible appearance, image-relative location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relationships. State uncertainty; do not infer hidden fasteners, weight or permanent installation. Do not classify stability or mobility. Use English text.
Required JSON structure (the angle-bracket text specifies field meaning, not example objects):
{"scene_description":"<full scene description>","objects":[{"id":1,"label":"<visible object name>","observation":"<visible appearance, location, occlusion, supports, contacts and relations>","attachment_evidence":"not_visible","identifiable":true}]}
List all discernible objects, not just one. Every object needs these five fields. attachment_evidence must be visible_installation, appears_freestanding, not_visible or mixed; visible_installation requires visible mounting or integration. Use not_visible when attachment cannot be established. scene_description about 120 words or fewer; each observation about 60 words or fewer.

Describe the photograph using these inputs:
{"frame_id": "thud_dense_test50/image-000012", "image_size": [960, 540], "annotation_kind": "unspecified", "supplied_objects": null}<|im_end|>
<|im_start|>assistant
